grammar.pattern: 想 + verb · 要 + verb / noun
grammar.purpose: Distinguish a wish from a decision
grammar.explanation: 想 + verb expresses a wish or inclination: 想去. 要 + verb often expresses a decision, intention or need. 要 + noun orders or requests something: 我要米饭. Context matters; 要 does not always mean an obligation. Negate a wish with 不想. 不要 can sound like a refusal or prohibition. Soften invitations with 吗 or 吧.

commonMistakes.why: For wanting to buy something, put the verb 买 after 想; 要两张票 directly requests tickets.

grammar.purpose: Add a shared interest or another activity
grammar.explanation: 也 adds a matching fact about another person or activity: 我也想去. 还 adds something further or indicates continuation: 还要吃饭 / 还在看. Both come before the predicate, after the subject. 还有 introduces another item that is available. Do not put 也 at the end as if it were English “too”.

examples.py: tā xiǎng dǎ qiú , wǒ yě xiǎng dǎ qiú .
examples.en: She wants to play ball; I do too.

examples.py: wǒ men kàn diàn yǐng , hái xiǎng chī fàn .
examples.en: We are watching a film and also want to eat.

examples.py: tā hái zài kàn diàn yǐng .
examples.en: He is still watching the film.

examples.py: wǒ yǒu miàn bāo , hái yǒu niú nǎi .
examples.en: I have bread and also milk.

commonMistakes.why: Place 也 before 想, not at the end.

dialogue.title: Tickets for tonight
dialogue.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
dialogue.purpose: Listen for the plan and the reason for changing it.

lines.zh: 你晚上想看电影吗？
lines.py: nǐ wǎn shang xiǎng kàn diàn yǐng ma ?
lines.en: Do you feel like seeing a film tonight?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 想。我爱看电影。
lines.py: xiǎng . wǒ ài kàn diàn yǐng .
lines.en: Yes. I love watching films.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我也想去，电影院就在学校旁边。
lines.py: wǒ yě xiǎng qù , diàn yǐng yuàn jiù zài xué xiào páng biān .
lines.en: I want to go too. The cinema is right next to the school.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 门票多少钱？
lines.py: mén piào duō shao qián ?
lines.en: How much is an admission ticket?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 三十块。我还有两张票。
lines.py: sān shí kuài . wǒ hái yǒu liǎng zhāng piào .
lines.en: Thirty yuan. I also have two tickets.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好。可是我有点儿饿。
lines.py: hǎo . kě shì wǒ yǒu diǎn ér è .
lines.en: Good. But I am a little hungry.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那我们先吃饭，再看电影。
lines.py: nà wǒ men xiān chī fàn , zài kàn diàn yǐng .
lines.en: Then let us eat first and see the film afterwards.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行。我想吃米饭和菜。
lines.py: xíng . wǒ xiǎng chī mǐ fàn hé cài .
lines.en: Okay. I would like rice and a dish.
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 我想吃包子，还想喝牛奶。
lines.py: wǒ xiǎng chī bāo zi , hái xiǎng hē niú nǎi .
lines.en: I would like steamed buns and some milk too.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你不要面包了吗？
lines.py: nǐ bú yào miàn bāo le ma ?
lines.en: Do you not want bread now?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 今天不要。明天下午一起打球吧？
lines.py: jīn tiān bú yào . míng tiān xià wǔ yì qǐ dǎ qiú ba ?
lines.en: Not today. Shall we play ball together tomorrow afternoon?
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 好，我的爱好就是打球！
lines.py: hǎo , wǒ de ài hào jiù shì dǎ qiú !
lines.en: Yes. Playing ball is just my hobby!
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: An invitation with room to say no
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Find which invitation is accepted and which is declined.

lines.zh: 我的爱好是看电影和打球。
lines.py: wǒ de ài hào shì kàn diàn yǐng hé dǎ qiú .
lines.en: My hobbies are watching films and playing ball.

lines.zh: 朋友今天想去电影院，我也想看那个电影。
lines.py: péng you jīn tiān xiǎng qù diàn yǐng yuàn , wǒ yě xiǎng kàn nà gè diàn yǐng .
lines.en: My friend wants to go to the cinema today, and I want to see that film too.

lines.zh: 她有两张票，不用再买门票。
lines.py: tā yǒu liǎng zhāng piào , bù yòng zài mǎi mén piào .
lines.en: She has two tickets, so there is no need to buy admission tickets again.

lines.zh: 我们都饿了，先在学校吃饭。
lines.py: wǒ men dōu è le , xiān zài xué xiào chī fàn .
lines.en: We are both hungry, so we eat at school first.

lines.zh: 她吃米饭和菜，我吃包子，喝牛奶。
lines.py: tā chī mǐ fàn hé cài , wǒ chī bāo zi , hē niú nǎi .
lines.en: She eats rice and a dish; I eat steamed buns and drink milk.

lines.zh: 桌上还有面包，可是我们不想吃。
lines.py: zhuō shàng hái yǒu miàn bāo , kě shì wǒ men bù xiǎng chī .
lines.en: There is also bread on the table, but we do not feel like eating it.

lines.zh: 她明天还想打球，可是我要学中文。
lines.py: tā míng tiān hái xiǎng dǎ qiú , kě shì wǒ yào xué zhōng wén .
lines.en: She also wants to play ball tomorrow, but I am going to study Chinese.

lines.zh: 我说：今天去看电影，明天不去打球。
lines.py: wǒ shuō : jīn tiān qù kàn diàn yǐng , míng tiān bù qù dǎ qiú .
lines.en: I say: we can see a film today, but I will not play ball tomorrow.

lines.zh: 她说：好，球在我家，下次一起玩。
lines.py: tā shuō : hǎo , qiú zài wǒ jiā , xià cì yì qǐ wán .
lines.en: She says: okay, the ball is at my place; we can play together next time.

pragmatics.situation: Decline while leaving the door open

natural.zh: 不好意思，明天我要学习。下次吧。
